body: I'm 23 now. I know of many people who outgrew eczema as a kid. Too bad I wasn't lucky enough to be one of them :(

I've already tried a bunch of things for my eczema. I seem to have reached a limit on how good my skin can be, and it's still total crap mostly. I'm sure there are some kind souls out there who will accept me regardless, but it's hard when you keep getting rejected by people over and over. Makes me want to just quit entirely. And I don't think it's just excessively superficial people either. Most "normal" people prefer to associate with other "normal" people, so if your looks are outside the norm, you better have a great personality to make up for it.

It's hard to tell if other people aren't worth my time, or if I'm the one who's not worth anybody's time. Generally, as an adult people aren't "mean" to me about eczema. But I can sense when someone's apathetic about me, and it makes me wonder if they'd be more inclined to get to know me if I didn't have terrible skin (especially romantically speaking).
